scope: Charge locally parsed LTYPE description and complex-segment text on the existing table-entry retained-byte lease, without asserting a DXF group-9 length rule or promoting external support claims.

method.kind: Generated ASCII/Binary DXF record and full TABLES reader controls
method.temporaryOutput: The generated Binary DXF TABLES source is written to a unique path under the system temporary directory and removed by RAII cleanup.

assertions: Group-3 description replacement charges the final live value rather than retaining historical values.
Every group-9 string across two valid complex segments is charged to the shared table-entry lease.
The minimum successful aggregate cap accepts the full stream; one byte under rejects the final long replacement before assignment and preserves the prior dash text.
After reader-record teardown, the lease equals the name, current description, and all current segment text lengths.
A repeated group-73 size record releases the superseded segment-text charges before parsing the replacement segment array.
Copy and move preserve the shared lease; resetting the source does not release the last owner, and final reset releases all retained bytes.

controls.encoding: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF TABLES drawings
assertions: At the one-byte-under facade cap, the LTYPE table fails with the retained-byte ResourceLimit diagnostic before any LTYPE callback.
Raising the budget on the same dxfRW facade succeeds and publishes the complex LTYPE plus the following SENTINEL_LTYPE row.
The complex row preserves its description and both segment text values; the following row proves table cursor alignment.
A separate generated ASCII/Binary drawing with code 9 but no `74` text flag is rejected as BAD_CODE_PARSED before publishing either row.

doesNotEstablish: the normative DXF group-9 field length for any target version or code page
independent producer or native CAD acceptance of complex LTYPE text
DWG fixed-area LTYPE text capacity or cross-format equivalence
process RSS, vector/string capacity, post-parse public mutation, or caller-copy memory accounting
resolution of LibreDWG #1450–#1452 or ACadSharp #1282–#1283 as matching local defects
broader DWG/DXF feature completeness or support parity

compatibility.publicClassLayoutChanged: DRW_LType gains private retained-byte counters; downstream consumers must rebuild.

planImpact.nextGate: Keep the DXF group-9 field profile pending until a pinned, versioned producer/native witness distinguishes character and encoded-byte limits; continue other local implementation-ready work without waiting on that external gate.
